description: R4: least-privilege, read-only reader of the tier/tenant-partitioned metrics ledgers (active/shared/runtime/execution-metrics/, active/shared/runtime/usage-ledger/). libs/core metrics.ts assumes it only inside aggregateMetricsForEnforcement, bound to the caller's tenant, so cap enforcers (spend guard, org budget governor, generation-cost dedup) count every tier of their scope whatever the caller's persona; the call returns numbers only, never rows. No write, no knowledge/ access (persona worker).
